title: Triple ergodic averages with distinct integer slopes
main_claim: For any invertible mixing probability-preserving T, any pairwise distinct nonzero integers λ1,λ2,λ3 and any bounded f_j, (1/N)Σ_{n≤N} Π f_j(T^{λ_j n}x) converges a.e. to Π∫f_j. The proof deduces this from a local estimate with variation in depth (Thm 2.2). That estimate extends the four-linear local estimates of the companion papers H and V from slopes 0,1,2,3 to general slopes 0,b1,b2,b3.

issues.description: The analytic core is a proof by reference. The localization, mode construction, row and stack estimates and stopping-time parameter argument of the companions H and V are said to carry over with fixed slope-dependent factors, but they are not re-proved. The main theorem is therefore conditional on H and V, which are unverified here. I found no concrete failing step in the coefficient-dependent modifications that the paper does state.
issues.evidence: The introduction says 'the technical part is a proof by reference to those manuscripts'. Section 6 cites H Sec 10 and V Sec 7 for the retained-cell estimate (6.1) and states its constants without derivation.

coverage:
Section 3 (transference from Thm 2.2 to Thm 1.1) checked independently, line by line:
- Lemma tr-kernel: the W=ΠL_jF construction, support margin <3/8, line cancellations and the z-integral giving Δ_k.
- Lemma tr-real: lattice-averaging identity and depth reversal.
- Lemma tr-integer: Bezout planting. Checked |p_j-(m+b_jn)|<ρ(2+|b_j|E_b) and the error bound A_ρ L 2^{-k}.
- Oscillation proposition: block variation ≤1/(2√w) and telescoping; Calderón orbit transfer with Q chosen so no terms are cut off.
- Oscillation implies a.e. convergence.
- VdC induction: slopes a_j−a_1 and mixing as h→∞.
- Summation by parts for the weighted norm limit; moment-corrected profiles; floor(c2^k) identity and rational-grid completion.
Section 2 coefficient lemma checked (Bezout and Vandermonde c_j=1/P'(b_j)). In Section 4, sympy confirms Σα=Σα b=0 and S_α=(b_i−b_a)(b_i−b_l), and the full separation identity was checked by hand. The mixed-curvature identity c_iξ_iζ_i=−c_jξ_jζ_j follows from the y_a·y_l coefficient of Σc_p y_p^2=0. The Section 6 exponent arithmetic (q choice ⇒ P^{-1/4}) was checked. Internals of H and V were not checked, and most of Section 5 (arithmetic) was not re-checked by me.
sibling_notes: The board already had a no_gap_found entry for this same dir with the same minor caveat (conditional on H and V). My independent re-check of Section 3 and the coefficient algebra agrees with it. I updated that board entry.
